# FISTILAND SCUM Server

> FISTILAND is a European PvP SCUM server built around territory wars: loot x5, fast respawns, easier survival, squads of up to 10, no mechs. This wiki explains every server setting and is written in 8 languages (English, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Polski, Українська, Hrvatski).

To join: open SCUM, go to MULTIPLAYER, search for "FISTILAND" or type the server address 31.214.207.109:8159, then click CONNECT. Community: https://discord.gg/RHkNGk6ZQN

## Start here

- [New player guide](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/guide/): the first hour on the server, step by step.
- [FAQ](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/faq/): short answers about joining, PvP, bases, respawn, loot and events.
- [Glossary](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/glossary/): the words used by the server.

## Server settings

- [Overview](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/server/overview/): what the server is, how to join, summary of the settings.
- [Territory](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/server/territory-wars/): flags, base size, decay, raid protection, squads.
- [Respawn](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/server/respawn/): methods, prices and waiting times.
- [Economy](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/server/economy/): loot, trader prices, quests.
- [Progression](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/server/progression/): skill multipliers and fame points.
- [Survival](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/server/survival/): day and night, vehicles, animals.
- [Enemies](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/server/enemies/): zombies and armed NPCs.
- [Events](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/server/events/): cargo drops, no mechs.
- [Bunkers](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/server/bunkers/): access cards and abandoned bunkers.
- [Rules](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/server/rules/): fair play and server limits.
- [All settings](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/server/all-settings/): every value of the server's ServerSettings.ini.

## More

- [Maps](https://indforge-studio.github.io/FISTILAND/maps/): animal habitats and mutant sightings on the satellite map.
